Genealogy reference: BORI Critical Edition of the Mahabharata (Pune), mainly Adi Parva chs. 57–63, 89–90, 94–117 and later parvas, via the K. M. Ganguli and J. A. B. van Buitenen translations; Harivamsha and the Bhagavata, Vishnu, Matsya, Vayu, Brahma, Brahmanda, Agni, Garuda, Padma, Kurma, Linga, Markandeya, Skanda, Shiva, Brahmavaivarta, Vamana and Devi Bhagavata Puranas (plus Valmiki Ramayana genealogies) for the creation, Solar, Lunar, Yadava and allied dynasty lines; variant readings are noted per person. Portraits: major-character portraits are AI-generated illustrations in a consistent epic-painting style, not historical likenesses; others use initials placeholders. Mythic parentage is labelled. Dates: birth/death years are traditional estimates on one Puranic generation reckoning (Kali Yuga begins 3102 BCE, Kurukshetra war 3139 BCE; Puranic dynastic spans for later Magadha kings; 25 years per generation from the nearest anchor, with Solar, Lunar and Yadava king-lists interpolated between anchors), not historical fact; mythic lifespans are noted on the person.
